_note: This file describes the design system the app actually uses. It replaced the generic scaffold guidelines, which contradicted themselves (2-3x more spacing AND high density; glassmorphism AND no AI slop). Follow this and the app stays consistent.
product: Haul Yeah Moving — internal operations app. Password-gated. No customers see it.
priority: Phone first. Crew and sales live on a phone in a truck. Desktop is the owner's dense read of the same data.

single_source_of_truth.tailwind: frontend/tailwind.config.js maps every token to a utility
single_source_of_truth.rule: Never write a raw hex or a raw Tailwind palette class (slate-400, red-600, emerald-50) in a component. If a colour is missing, add a token.

colour.ground: --background, a warm off-white. Cards are --surface (white). Wells and inactive segments are --surface-sunk.
colour.ink: --foreground for primary text, --ink-2 for secondary, --faint for labels and metadata. All three clear 4.5:1 on white.
colour.brand: --primary #1B2A4A navy for structure and the nav. --navy-deep for the nav bars.
colour.accent: --accent #E8743B is the ACTION colour and nothing else. Never use it for status, decoration, or emphasis.
colour.accent_text: --accent-ink when orange has to be text or an icon on a light surface. --accent stays bright on navy.
colour.accent_foreground: Near-black, not white. White on #E8743B is 3.09:1 and fails AA at button sizes; near-black on the same orange is 5.9:1 and keeps the exact brand hex.
colour.status: --success, --warning, --destructive, --info. These describe state (paid, late, overdue, scheduled). They are never buttons.

typography.display: Cabinet Grotesk (Fontshare), 700/800, tracking -0.028em. Names, figures, page titles.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans. Everything read as a sentence.
typography.numbers: Every figure carries .tnum (tabular numerals) so columns line up.

scale.page_title: 22px phone / 26px desktop, weight 800. Not 36-48px — the nav already said where you are.
scale.section_label: .label-eyebrow — 11px, 700, uppercase, 0.12em tracking, --faint. The only uppercase text in the app.

typography.rule: Three sizes per screen. Hierarchy comes from weight and colour, not from ever-larger text.

action_ladder.why: The old cards showed seven identical outline buttons, so nothing was the next step.
levels: accent — the one thing to do on this panel. Full-width band in the thumb zone on a phone. Never more than one per panel.
outline — the two or three actions reached for on most jobs.
text link — everything else. Still one tap away, visually quiet.
action_ladder.labels: Name the verb and the object: "Call Danielle", not "Call".
action_ladder.contextual: The primary action follows nextStepHint() in lib/fields.js, so the sentence and the button never disagree.

surface.card: .surface — white, 1px --border, 12px radius. .surface-interactive adds a hover lift on pointer devices only.
surface.radius: 12px cards, 10px buttons, 8px inputs. Nothing is a pill except badge counts.
surface.shadow: Almost never. One soft lift on hover, one pop for floating panels. No glassmorphism, no glow, no gradients.

motion.buttons: Every button scales to 0.975 on press and transitions its own colours. Never transition-all.
motion.page: Route content fades up 6px on mount.
motion.sheets_menus: sheet-up for the mobile More sheet, pop-in for floating panels.
motion.status: The late-lead clock ticks. Nothing else loops.
motion.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion disables all of it. Honour it.

navigation.phone: Four fixed destinations per role plus More. The More sheet holds the rest, grouped, plus privacy / refresh / account / log out.
navigation.desktop: Grouped sidebar — Today, Sales, Money, Team, Business. Global jump-to palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) in the header.
navigation.rule: Never put more than five items in the phone tab bar. A horizontally scrolling nav strip is not navigation.

components.buttons: Always icon + word. Minimum 44px tall on a phone (h-11), 40px on desktop.
components.instruction_banners: One quiet line with an icon at the top of every screen. Not a coloured box.
components.figures: Use <Figure> for any number the owner reads. Label above, number on its own line, caption below. Nothing overlaps it.
components.empty_states: Use <EmptyState>. Say what will appear here and what puts it there.
components.empty_rosters: Do not render thirteen rows of "Not active right now". Show what is happening and put the rest behind a toggle.
components.tables: Hide non-essential columns below sm: rather than crushing them.
components.calendars: On phones a day cell is ~44px wide. Show one dot per job with a legend, not three characters of a job name.
components.tabs: TabsList scrolls horizontally. It must never wrap to a second line.

accessibility.contrast: Every text style clears WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large). Verified programmatically across all 62 screen/viewport combinations.
accessibility.focus: One focus ring for the whole app, defined in index.css.
accessibility.icons: Decorative icons carry aria-hidden. Icon-only controls carry aria-label.
accessibility.overlap: No text may overlap or clip. Audited across every route at 390px and 1440px.

data_display.tracking_fields: utm_*, fbclid, fbc, fbp and friends are collapsed behind a toggle on the lead card. A sales rep does not need a Facebook click ID.
data_display.privacy_mode: Wrap any customer name, phone, email, address or dollar figure in <Private> or <Money> so the header toggle can mask it.

protected_functionality: Airtable proxy and the field-ID map in lib/fields.js
Auth, role gating and the RoleRoutes table in App.js
Quote logic in lib/quote.js and lib/pricing.js
Meta CAPI, GPS pings, optimistic writes in AppContext
